appearance.darkModeDescription: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting

shutdown.dialogTitle: Do you want to turn off your Lokihub?
shutdown.dialogDesc: This will turn off your Lokihub and make your node offline. You won't be able to send or receive flokicoin until you unlock it.
shutdown.toast: Your node has been turned off.

changePassword.title: Unlock Password
changePassword.description: Change unlock password to your Hub. Your node will restart after password change.
changePassword.importantDesc: Password can't be reset or recovered. Make sure to back it up!

autoUnlock.title: Auto Unlock
autoUnlock.description: Configure Lokihub will automatically unlock on start (e.g. after machine reboot)
autoUnlock.bodyText: In some situations it can be impractical to manually unlock the wallet every time Lokihub is started. In those cases you can save the unlock password in plaintext so that Lokihub can auto-unlock itself.
autoUnlock.attentionDesc: Everyone who has access to the machine running this hub could read that password and take your funds. Use this only in a secure environment.

developer.title: Developer
developer.nwcDesc: Lokihub can power your lightning apps and services in all environments using Nostr Wallet Connect, an open protocol to connect lightning wallets and apps
developer.apiDesc: You can use your auth token to access the Lokihub internal API. However, whenever possible, we recommend using the NWC API directly for more stability. Please note that the internal API may change or be removed entirely in the future.
developer.fullAccessDesc: Complete control over your hub - can read data and perform all operations (send payments, manage apps, etc.)
developer.readonlyAccessDesc: View-only access - can read balances, transactions, and other data but cannot perform operations

withdraw.switchDescription: Lets Cash Hubs on this node pay bills out to on-chain addresses (cash_withdraw). Each Cash Hub also turns them on for itself.
withdraw.notCapable: This node's backend cannot pay on-chain withdrawals.
withdraw.offered: Offered to this Cash Hub's bills now
withdraw.notOffered: Not offered to this Cash Hub's bills

blocked.nodeOff: Turn on-chain withdrawals on for the node in Settings first.
blocked.notCapable: This node's backend cannot pay on-chain withdrawals.

errors.feeBase: The fee base is a loki amount of at most three decimals.
errors.feePpm: The fee rate is a whole number from 0 to {{max}} ppm.
errors.min: The minimum is a loki amount of at most three decimals.
errors.max: The maximum is a loki amount of at most three decimals.
errors.minAboveMax: The minimum is above the maximum.

withdraw.networkFeeNote: The network fee is estimated live by the node for each address type and added to the quote.
withdraw.saveFailed: Could not save the on-chain withdrawal terms

payouts.title: On-chain payouts
payouts.description: This Cash Hub's on-chain withdrawals, newest first. No operator action changes a payout; only the bill's holder can ask to cancel one.
